abstract: Unlike periodic field-intensity patterns, which can be generated by interference of coherent beams, periodic material structures are usually created by periodic modification. In contrast, we show here that a millimeter-long bundle of four conventional side-coupled optical fibers with a slowly varying transverse arrangement can support a nearly periodic array of whispering-gallery-mode microresonators, whose period can be tuned mechanically down to about $100\,μ\mathrm{m}$.
